goal.required_fact_coverage.question: Did the answer cover the required facts for applicable golden cases?
goal.required_fact_coverage.retirement_condition: Review after 90 days at 100% without changing an answer-quality decision.

goal.retrieval_recall_at_20.question: Did retrieval recall the expected sources in the first 20 results?
goal.retrieval_recall_at_20.retirement_condition: Review after 90 days at 100% without changing a retrieval decision.

goal.selected_context_recall_at_5.question: Did the first five selected context records retain the required sources?
goal.selected_context_recall_at_5.retirement_condition: Review after 90 days at 100% without changing a context-selection decision.

guardrail.abstention_correctness.question: Did every case make the expected answer-versus-abstain decision?
guardrail.abstention_correctness.retirement_condition: Retire only when the abstention constraint is formally removed.

guardrail.citation_resolve_rate.question: Did every trial emit only citations that resolve to its selected context?
guardrail.citation_resolve_rate.retirement_condition: Retire only when the citation-resolution constraint is formally removed.

guardrail.cross_version_contamination_co.question: How many non-comparison trials mixed evidence from incompatible document versions?
guardrail.cross_version_contamination_co.retirement_condition: Retire only when the document-version isolation constraint is formally removed.

guardrail.permission_bypass_count.question: How many denied trials performed private retrieval before terminating?
guardrail.permission_bypass_count.retirement_condition: Retire only when the permission-before-retrieval constraint is formally removed.

operational.completed_requests_per_hour.question: How many requests complete per hour for the fixed sequential evaluation profile?
operational.completed_requests_per_hour.retirement_condition: Review after 90 days without informing a throughput or capacity decision.

operational.cost_per_request.question: What observed or provider-profile estimate is spent per evaluated request?
operational.cost_per_request.retirement_condition: Review after 90 days without informing a provider or cost decision.

operational.end_to_end_latency_p95.question: What is the P95 end-to-end latency for the fixed evaluation profile?
operational.end_to_end_latency_p95.retirement_condition: Review after 90 days without informing a latency or capacity decision.
